title: Installation Minutes per Endpoint Unit on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
**Installation minutes schedule.** The minutes drawn for a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours installation visit depend on the order type of the Hardware Procurement order the installation is priced on:

- an installation visit for a **Staged Endpoint Order** is drawn at 20 minutes for each unit of the order, the units arriving imaged, whatever the ticket's billable minutes;
- an installation visit for a **Standard Endpoint Order** is drawn at the larger of its rounded billable minutes, with the onsite minimum, and 45 minutes for each unit, imaging being done on site;
- an installation visit for **any other order type** is drawn at its rounded billable minutes with the onsite minimum.

The units are the units ordered on that Hardware Procurement order; the rounded billable minutes are the resolution's billable minutes rounded up to the size's billing increment and taken to the size's onsite minimum.

| Order type (hypothetical 8 units, 240 rounded billable minutes) | Minutes drawn |
|---|---|
| Staged Endpoint Order | 8 times 20, that is 160 |
| Standard Endpoint Order | the larger of 240 and 8 times 45 (360), that is 360 |
| Network Equipment Order or another type | 240 |

With 3 units on a Standard Endpoint Order and 240 rounded minutes, 3 times 45 is 135 and the visit is drawn at 240.
